name: I Will Purify You
storyline:
Creatures once believed to exist only in myth—Anomalies—have begun appearing across the real world.
These beings, awakened from legends and folklore, are the bosses you must confront.

To stop the spreading chaos, James—the exorcist of the Soul Demon Hunters (that’s you, sir!)—sets out on a global journey to purify them.

The only one who can stop this myth-bred disaster from consuming the world… is you.
summary: I Will Purify You (I.P.U.) is a 2D pixel side-scroll action game where you play as James, an exorcist of the Hunter Union. Battle countless Anomalies and purify powerful, alluring female bosses to restore peace to a world consumed by chaos.
